name: March of the Canonized
oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, create X 1/1 white Vampire creature tokens with lifelink.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if your devotion to white and black is seven or greater, create a 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature token with flying.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your upkeep, if your devotion to white and black is seven or greater, create a 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature token with flying.

needs.what: a value for devotion to two colours (rule 700.5a), usable in a trigger's intervening-if condition: the number of mana symbols in the mana costs of permanents you control that are white OR black, where a hybrid {W/B} pip counts once, not twice -- e.g. mana_symbols accepting a list `of: ["W", "B"]` that counts each pip at most once if it contains any listed colour
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_symbols takes a single colour in `of` (validate_mana_symbols refuses anything else), and a sum of mana_symbols W plus mana_symbols B double-counts every {W/B} hybrid pip because Requirement.symbols_of in engine/mana.py counts a hybrid pip for each of its colours, so the upkeep trigger would make the Vampire Demon too early; the tokens themselves (vampire_1_1_w_lifelink, vampire_demon_4_3_wb_flying) and the upkeep trigger already exist
